proposition: Only two sons are known by name: Jamāl al-Dīn Muḥammad, for whom Ibn Turka wrote the logic manual K. al-Manāhij, and Najīb al-Dīn Ḥabīb Allāh, who appears to have written a brief lettrist treatise, Qavāʿid-i Jafr-i Jāmiʿ.
